In this role as a Dealer Risk Management Analyst, you will be responsible for: Reviewing Internal Risk Controls - Analyzing internal risk management frameworks covering market, credit, leverage, liquidity, legal, and operational risks at Alternative Net Capital (ANC) firms, OTC Derivatives Dealers (OTCDDs), and Security-Based Swap Dealers (SBSDs) to assess their effectiveness in managing firm-wide exposures.

Analyzing Financial & Risk Filings - Reviewing and evaluating monthly, quarterly, and annual regulatory filings containing financial, risk management, and operational data submitted by ANC firms, OTCDDs, and SBSDs.

Engaging Senior Risk Managers - Participating in regular meetings with firm senior risk managers to review business unit risk-taking activities, aggregate risk metrics, independent risk control functions, and control processes supporting enterprise-wide risk management.

Supporting Agency Decision-Making - Compiling findings, preparing written reports and oral presentations, and contributing analytical support that directly informs SEC leadership recommendations and regulatory actions.

Representing the Agency - Interacting with industry representatives and peers at other federal and international agencies to coordinate research, resolve issues, and support the effective operations of your assigned organization.

Competency 3: Critical Thinking: Considers a variety of factors, general and subject matter-specific, when making decisions and determining next steps in a case.

Competency 4: Teamwork and Collaboration: Interacts with internal and external others in a manner that advances SEC goals and objectives.

In accordance with Office of Personnel Management policy, federal employees are assumed to have gained experience by performing duties and responsibilities appropriate for their official series and grade level as described in their position description.

Experience that would not normally be part of the employee's position is creditable, however, when documented by satisfactory evidence, such as a signed memorandum from the employee's supervisor or an SF-50 or SF-52 documenting an official detail or other official assignment.

The documentation must indicate whether the duties were performed full time or, if part time, the percentage of times the other duties were performed. It is expected that this documentation is included in the employee's official personnel record.

In order to receive credit for experience in your resume that is not within the official series and grade level of your official position, you must provide a copy of the appropriate documentation of such experience as indicated above.

We encourage you to read this entire vacancy announcement prior to submitting your application. As a Management and Program Analyst, GS-0343-11, you will be responsible for:
· Provides technical assistance and direct support to management staff.
· Assists with the implementation of new procedures and workflow enhancements impacting office operations.
· Communicates effectively with internal and external customers regarding operational processes, service concerns, and program-related initiatives.
· Completes assigned projects across multiple administrative functions accurately and on time. As a Management and Program Analyst, GS-0343-12, you will be responsible for:
· Evaluates administrative functions to identify ways to improve efficiency, effectiveness, productivity, and customer service.
· Oversees and executes various administrative support functions including budget, contracts, time and attendance, records, emergency preparedness, and space and facilities management.
· Interprets and ensures compliance with administrative rules, regulations, and policies.
· Establishes and maintains information reporting systems to track the status of administrative actions. As a Management and Program Analyst (Consumer Education and Financial Literacy Specialist), GS-0343-12, you will be responsible for:
· Developing and supporting consumer education and financial literacy content, campaigns, and outreach products. Planning, developing, and coordinating educational materials, campaign content, presentations, toolkits, digital content, and other resources that help students, parents, borrowers, and other consumers understand federal student aid and make informed financial decisions.
· Analyzing customer insights, program data, and stakeholder feedback to improve consumer education efforts. Reviewing qualitative and quantitative information to identify trends, assess customer needs, evaluate campaign or content effectiveness, and recommend improvements to educational products and outreach activities.
· Coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to support consumer education priorities. Working with FSA program offices, communications teams, digital product teams, servicing organizations, vendors, schools, and other stakeholders to develop, coordinate, and deliver consumer education and financial literacy activities.

The Associate Chief Counsel (Finance & Management) supports the administrative, financial, and managerial programs of the Office of Chief Counsel and provides advice to the Chief Counsel and Deputy Chief Counsel on all management matters for the organization nationwide.

This position, in the Planning & Finance Division, performs a range of duties including data querying and analysis, budget planning and execution, survey administration and analysis, and strategic planning.

Analysts in PFD also partner with Human Resources, Talent Management, Business Systems Planning and other Counsel functions to deliver on cross-functional programs and projects related to employee engagement, organizational development, and Enterprise Risk Management.

As a Management Analyst, you will: Conduct in depth, independent research and analysis on a wide range of complex and sensitive management issues; Serve as project leader, consultant or a member on various project teams that resolve complex management problems and to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of operations; Create, manage, and/or query management databases containing statistical information.

Utilize appropriate programs and software tools to design and perform complex analyses and to clearly report on findings and recommendations; Gather, maintain, and analyze data related to costs and performance of a wide range of services and work products to determine return on investment, productivity, or effectiveness; Serve on task forces, ad hoc committees, teams to conduct in depth analyses of the programs and/or systems studied.

Participate in operational reviews and audits of management information systems and other processes for the purpose of improving the efficiency and effectiveness and assessing internal controls, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations. This is not an all-inclusive list.

If selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform the duties of the position, and will receive training to help you grow in the position.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS-09).

OR Education Substitution: You may substitute education for specialized experience as follows: Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree in a field which demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work of the position.

OR Combination of Education and Experience: You may qualify by a combination of experience and education: Options for qualifying based on a combination are identified in the online questions.

For GS-12: Specialized Experience: Your resume must detail at least one year of specialized experience which includes: Using various analytical methods - both quantitative and qualitative - to analyze program and/or organizational efficiency and effectiveness; support development of recommendations related to strategic planning, organizational development, and resource allocation or budgeting and preparing information for leadership or program principals; serving as a principal team member on cross-functional project related to management and administration; maintaining and querying databases and leveraging data to analyze and develop recommendations on complex management and administration issues; using data analysis and data reporting skills to develop recommendations and findings; collaborating on program implementation.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS-11). NOTE: If qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application package.

Duties may include but are not limited to: Serves as an on-site management representative for the Community-Based Outpatient Clinic, overseeing daily operations to ensure efficient patient flow, effective use of resources, and adherence to established clinical, administrative, and organizational processes.

Provides operational oversight and coordination across clinic functions, helping ensure that patient care delivery, front-line administrative activities, provider support, and clinic workflows are aligned with facility expectations and access-to-care goals.

Coordinates space planning, facility maintenance concerns, equipment requests, supply needs, and logistical support to promote a safe, functional, and efficient care environment for Veterans, staff, and visitors.

Fosters solid relationships by keeping staff members informed, being responsive to their requests, and obtaining information and expertise to present on specific issues and programs.

Conducts periodic reviews and analysis of issues and the systems associated with those issues that have come forward from Veterans and their family members and presents that information, along with recommended programmatic change, to the Medical Center Director and the Executive Board.

Collects and analyzes administrative and performance data including workload, access metrics, productivity, and resource utilization.

Ensures that CBOC operations are conducted in accordance with established clinical, administrative, safety, privacy, and information security requirements, helping maintain consistency between the CBOC and parent facility expectations.

Compiles summary and executive level reports related to the program; provides guidance to medical staff and other providers regarding pending and completed actions by major program. Addresses escalated Veteran concerns and ensures appropriate documentation and follow-through.

Specific duties include: Leads the change management activity across business lines within the Regional Office (RO) and focuses on implementing changes to business processes, systems, technology, and job roles.

Primary focus will be creating and implementing change management plans that maximize employee engagement, and drives faster adoption, greater utilizations, and higher proficiency on the changes impacting employees and the agency. Influences others to move toward VBA's common vision and goal.

Assists the RO Director in assessing priorities/training and resource needs to meet program objectives through the development and execution of stakeholder communication, relationship management, and organizational change management strategies. Serves as liaison between the Implementation Center (IC) and the RO.

Makes recommendations to the IC that may influence VBA policy and may change the direction of the strategic plan and implementation of initiatives. Assist the Director in developing a change management strategy to include a communication plan, implementation of a roadmap, coaching plan, training plan, and resistance management plan.

Provides sound advice and guidance to station management in achieving the RO's objectives. Partners with the project management team, OI&T, the IC, and appropriate business lines to develop change management plans for each project. Evaluates and positively influences rollout timing and scope to suit business needs.

Ensures that appropriate business lines are engaged in change management planning and provides detailed input to project implementation plans. Supports management on significant issues such as: policies, goals & objectives, internal controls, and preparation of priority reports to the Director, VACO, and OFO.

Assist or perform evaluations of the processes of various systematic analysis of operations to determine the level of quality & management factors of all program's areas.

Conducts the strategic communications program for the Regional Office with responsibility for developing and providing guidance involving all public affairs information, internal communications, Veterans' service organizations liaison, congressional and community relations activities and is the liaison for Veterans' service organizations, congressionalstaffs, community groups, professional organizations, etc.

To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement:08/10/2026. TIME-IN-GRADE REQUIREMENT: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements.

For a GS-11 position, you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-09. For a GS-12 position, you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-11. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENT: You may qualify based on your experience and/or education as described below: GS-11 Grade Level: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade (GS-9) in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Specialized experience for the GS-11 level may include performing work that demonstrates progressively responsible analytical, organizational, and consultative skills in support of organizational effectiveness initiatives.

Experience should reflect competency in at least two of the following areas: Diagnosing organizational issues: Assisting in identifying operational, structural, or process-related problems within the organization; gathering and analyzing relevant data to understand the underlying drivers of these issues; and contributing to recommendations for improvement.

Building collaborative working relationships: Supporting engagement efforts with individuals at various levels of the organization; facilitating communication and cooperation across teams; and participating in activities that promote teamwork and organizational cohesion.

Supporting mission, vision, and goal development: Contributing to discussions or working groups focused on defining or refining the organization's mission, vision, values, and strategic goals; assisting in communicating these elements to stakeholders.

Participating in business process or system design: Assisting in the development or revision of business processes, workflow models, job roles, or supporting technologies to improve operational effectiveness and service delivery.

Assisting with implementation of organizational initiatives: Supporting the rollout of new organizational strategies, programs, or processes; contributing to action plans; and assisting with the delivery of training, communication, or educational materials related to change initiatives.

OR Education Substitution: Applicants may substitute education for the required experience. To qualify based on education, you must have: Three (3) full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D. degree or Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree or LL.M., if related. and obtained in an accredited college or university.

Note: Transcripts Required. OR Combination of Education and Experience: Applicants may also combine education and experience to qualify at the GS-11 level. To calculate, first identify the percentage of required education you have earned (when substituting, you cannot use the first 60 semester hours that you earned).

Then identify the percentage of required experience you possess. Add the two percentages. The total percentage must equal at least 100 percent to qualify at the GS-11.

GS-12 Grade Level: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-11 grade level, which reflects increasing independence, technical judgment, and responsibility.

Specialized experience for the GS-12 level includes performing work that demonstrates advanced proficiency in organizational analysis, strategic planning, and change implementation.

Power the Pacific Northwest's Clean Energy Future as Our Lead Compliance Systems Architect At the Bonneville Power Administration (BPA), we power the Pacific Northwest with clean, reliable energy while upholding the highest standards of public trust and regulatory excellence.

Standing at the intersection of technology, data, and organizational strategy, our team ensures the agency operates with integrity, efficiency, and agility.

As a Senior Management and Program Analyst within Governance and Internal Controls (Executive Office), you will serve as the principal technical authority driving the modernization of our enterprise-wide compliance and risk management systems.

In this high-visibility role, you will bridge the gap between executive leadership, business operations, and IT teams-transforming complex data into strategic insights and modernizing the digital tools that safeguard BPA's mission.

Key Responsibilities Shape Enterprise System Strategy: Direct the vision for enterprise compliance software initiatives, establishing strategic frameworks that prioritize high-impact technology projects and align system capabilities with agency goals.

Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration: Guide multidisciplinary groups of business leaders, program experts, IT specialists, and software vendors to design, develop, and implement modern governance and risk management solutions.

Architect Scalable & Secure Solutions: Oversee software architecture decisions to guarantee that enterprise system infrastructure is built for future expansion, robust cybersecurity, and advanced data reporting.

Solve Unprecedented Technical Challenges: Diagnose complex system bottlenecks, evaluate alternative technical strategies, and engineer creative solutions to resolve intricate, organization-wide process issues.

Transform Data into Strategic Insights: Harness advanced analytics and design intuitive data visualizations to track performance trends, measure operational effectiveness, and empower leadership to make data-informed decisions.

Champion Continuous Process Improvement: Drive organization-wide standardization by modernizing workflows, refining operating standards, and streamlining internal decision-making tools.

Guarantee Flawless System Deployments: Orchestrate end-to-end user testing and release planning, proactively monitoring software dependencies to prevent operational disruptions and ensure seamless software updates.

Serve as the Primary Technical Authority: Act as the final approval authority for system releases in live environments and serve as the main technical liaison between executive leadership, IT teams, and external software vendors.

Foundever 's NSOS Operational Efficiency team is scaling its Bill-to-Pay (BTP) Margin Recovery initiative — a structured analytical programme that identifies where Gross Margin (GM) is being lost at the account level and turns those findings into operational actions that drive measurable GM improvement across the EMEA region.
We are hiring a Business Analysts to extend coverage across the EMEA portfolio, supporting our goal of reviewing 50 accounts by the end of H2 2026.
The core of the role is a repeatable four-step process: (1) build an optimal BTP baseline for each account using financial performance data; (2) diagnose the gaps between that baseline and actual operational results, quantifying the GM opportunity by root cause; (3) translate findings into clear, prioritized recommendations and hand them off to Operations or Account Management for execution; and (4) track the evolution of each gap month-over-month to measure whether corrective actions are closing the performance shortfall.
You will not own the execution of corrective actions — that responsibility sits with Operations. Your role is to be the analytical engine behind the initiative: detecting, quantifying, communicating, and monitoring until each gap is resolved or escalated.

BTP Analysis & Gap Detection
For each assigned account, build a BTP baseline from financial performance data and WFM inputs to establish the optimal labour cost scenario.
Compare the optimal scenario based on the assumptions used for pricing against actual results (Theoretical Production, Actual, and Invoiced) to identify and size performance gaps by root cause: e.g. unplanned absenteeism, non-productive time, scheduling adherence failures, unbillable hours cap impact, internal shrinkage deviations, etc
Quantify the GM opportunity associated with each gap driver, at both the individual account level and aggregated across the portfolio.
Maintain a throughput of approximately 10 account analyses per Business Analyst every two weeks, consistent with the team's EMEA scaling roadmap.
Findings Communication & Operational Handoff
Translate analytical findings into structured, prioritized output (findings, root causes, recommended actions, estimated GM impact) formatted for handoff to Operations and Account Management.
Present conclusions clearly to non-technical stakeholders, focusing on the 'so what' — what needs to change, who owns it, and what the financial benefit of closing the gap is.
Coordinate with Operations and Account Management to validate findings and ensure recommended actions are operationally feasible before sign-off.
Monthly Follow-Up & Evolution Tracking
For accounts in active monitoring, track month-over-month BTP performance versus the established baseline to assess whether corrective actions are delivering the expected improvement.
Identify root-cause gaps that are improving, stagnating, or worsening, and escalate unresolved or recurring issues to the Director of Operational Efficiency with supporting evidence.
Maintain updated account records that document gap status, action ownership, and GM impact realised to date.
Process Consistency
Apply the team's standardized BTP methodology consistently across all assigned accounts and countries, ensuring comparability of findings across the EMEA portfolio.
Flag where data availability, data quality, or system limitations are constraining analysis accuracy, and contribute to the team's ongoing effort to improve data access and analytical automation.
What you need in order to be successful

2–4 years of experience in business analysis, workforce management analytics, financial operations analysis, or a related field — ideally within a BPO, contact center, or outsourced services environment.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
Proven experience working with financial performance data (P&L, margin, cost of labour) and operational metrics to generate actionable insight.
Technical Skills
Advanced Excel skills: structured analysis, financial modelling, pivot tables, formulas.
Solid understanding of workforce management concepts: shrinkage (internal and external), AUX/activity codes, scheduling adherence, login compliance, billable vs. paid hours.
Ability to work with WFM platform data exports (e.g. IEX) and account-level financial performance reports to build and validate BTP scenarios.
Comfortable working with incomplete, inconsistent, or manually compiled source data — able to apply structured judgement to reconcile discrepancies and document assumptions.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and root-cause-diagnosis mindset: able to move from a raw dataset to a clear, prioritized narrative about where margin is being lost and why.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to present complex financial and operational findings to non-technical stakeholders without requiring translation.
Organized and accountable: comfortable managing a recurring portfolio of accounts on a fixed monthly cadence, with clear documentation of status and progress.
Collaborative and assertive: able to work with Operations and Account Management to validate and land recommendations, without assuming ownership of their execution.
Languages
Fluent English required (written and spoken) — primary language for all reporting and stakeholder communication.
Additional French is a plus.
The work environment
A central role in a EMEA COO-sponsored, high-visibility initiative with direct, measurable impact on EMEA Gross Margin performance.
Exposure to senior cross-functional stakeholders across Operations, Account Management, and Finance.
A structured methodology to work within, with scope to help shape the team's evolution toward data automation and scalable analytics.
Career development within a growing analytics function at one of the world's leading customer experience companies.

A "certification" letter should be on letterhead of the appropriate military branch of the service and contain (1) the military service dates including the expected discharge or release date; and (2) the character of service.

It must be signed by, or by direction of, the adjutant, personnel officer, or commander of your unit or higher headquarters.

Active duty members that fail to provide a valid "certification" of service with their initial application will be found "not eligible". Members may be appointed before the effective date of their military retirement/separation if they are on terminal leave.

At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.
The Business Application Development team builds and supports internal and customer-facing systems for licenses, subscriptions, billing, payments, reporting, and many other business-critical functions. Our domain is complex, our systems are interconnected, and there’s always a lot going on. We’re seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join the team and support our efforts.
We’re not looking for someone who will just write requirements. We want someone who likes digging into problems, understanding how things actually work, talking to people, asking uncomfortable questions, and helping teams move toward practical and sustainable solutions.

You’ll work closely with stakeholders, developers, and QA engineers, as well as sales, customer success, and other product teams, to figure out what problem we’re really solving, why it matters, what constraints exist, and what solution makes the most sense long term.
A core responsibility is helping people stay focused on the actual goal instead of jumping straight to a “we need this exact feature” reaction. Though sometimes bigger, the right solution is often smaller than originally expected. The main job is frequently untangling the chaos and helping everyone align.
Organize and improve the intake and analysis process within the team.

s.h: Structure requirements to support effective development.
s.t:
Help developers and QA engineers during implementation when new questions arise.
Investigate unfamiliar areas independently rather than waiting for someone to explain.
Think about edge cases, dependencies, risks, and long-term maintainability.
Help reduce ambiguity around projects.
We care deeply about balancing business value, implementation effort, technical limitations, and platform strategy. We’re not fans of overengineering, but we also don’t like quick hacks that create bigger problems down the line.

s.h: We’ll be happy to bring you on board if you
s.t:
Have solid experience in business analysis within software development teams.
Understand how software development works end-to-end.
Know how to structure complex information and turn messy discussions into clear requirements.
Can stay focused on the core problem and avoid unnecessary complexity.
Are comfortable discussing implementation details with engineers and understanding technical constraints.
Can independently investigate unfamiliar functionality and connect dots across systems.
Care about the overall result, not only your direct area of responsibility.
Are proactive, curious, and comfortable working in an environment where not everything is perfectly documented.
Can adapt your communication style and analytical approach depending on the people and context involved.

s.h: It’d be a plus if you
s.t:
Can work with SQL.
Can read code well enough to understand what’s going on.
Have experience with technically complex systems or system analysis.
Have worked with billing, subscriptions, payments, or within other business-critical domains.

s.h: A few important things to know
s.t:
Our domain is genuinely complex. There’s a lot of history, many integrations, and a large codebase. You won’t learn everything in a month, and that’s okay.
We also continuously adjust processes and ways of working. If you like environments where everything is fixed and strictly defined forever, we’re probably not the best match. If you enjoy figuring things out, improving processes, and helping teams work more effectively together, you’ll likely feel very comfortable here.
Even though you’ll get the team’s full support and onboarding help, we really value people who are curious enough to explore things on their own.

About Perfected
When corporations cause harm, someone has to answer for it. At Perfected , we guide people through complex legal journeys with one clear goal: to hold corporations accountable and help communities reclaim their power.
We start with people—their stories, their pain, their hope—and we stand with them every step of the way. Our work is rooted in transparency, empathy, and advocacy. We partner with law firms across the country to bring clarity to chaos, amplify community voices, and create human-centered experiences that make justice feel within reach.
Location Note
These are remote-based positions and all work must be performed in a state in which Strategic Campaign Sourcing LLC is registered to do business (AL, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, IL, KY, LA, MA, ME, MI, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VI, VA, WI). Our preference is for applicants located -- or willing and able to work -- in the Pacific or Mountain time zones.

The Business Analyst will support the operational efficiency, data quality, and reporting needs of our Client Operations and Business Operations teams. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, and eager to build a strong foundation in operations, analytics, and process improvement.
As a Business Analyst, you’ll play a critical role in maintaining daily operational reporting, supporting data ingestion and quality control, tracking production and capacity metrics, and assisting with process documentation. You’ll work closely with Senior Program Leads, Program Leads, and cross-functional partners to ensure teams have accurate data, clear processes, and reliable insights to support decision-making.
This role provides hands-on exposure to operational workflows, reporting systems, and continuous improvement initiatives, with a clear growth path into Program Lead and Senior Program Lead roles over time.

Prepare and distribute daily, weekly, and ad hoc operational reports for internal stakeholders.
Support regular data uploads and track successful ingestion into key systems.
Perform quality control (QC) checks on operational data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Identify data discrepancies and escalate issues for resolution.
Maintain and update production tracking tools and capacity planning trackers.
Support workload analysis and resource utilization reporting.
Assist in identifying trends or potential risks related to volume, capacity, or throughput.
Compile, maintain, and manage client communication distribution lists to support accurate outreach.
Ensure lists and datasets are up to date and aligned with current operational requirements.
Support coordination across teams by providing timely and accurate data inputs.
Assist in drafting, updating, and maintaining SOPs, process documentation, and reference materials.
Contribute to process standardization efforts across programs.
Support implementation of updated workflows by ensuring documentation remains current
Assist in building dashboards and operational insights to support leadership decision-making.
Collaborate with Program Leads and Senior Program Leads on improvement initiatives.
Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and performance development conversations.
Take on additional analytical or operational support tasks as assigned.

Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.
1+ years of experience in operations, reporting, data support, or administrative roles.
Experience in legal, healthcare, or client services environments is a plus.
Familiarity with reporting systems, CRMs, or project management tools is helpful but not required.
Comfort working with large datasets and repetitive tasks while maintaining accuracy.
Proficiency in Excel (PivotTables, VLOOKUPs, formulas).
Skills & Abilities
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Clear written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
Willingness to learn, ask questions, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.
Adaptability in a fast-paced, evolving environment.​​​​​​

Frequent need for oral, written, and auditory communication.
Ability to sit for long periods of time.
Prolonged periods working on a computer.
Frequent repetitive hand and wrist motions.
Excellent near vision to see details on a computer screen, including color differentiation.
Ability to work in a fast paced and sometimes stressful services environment.
Occasional need for travel.

Time Off: PTO (15 days, earned on an accrual basis; increases at 3rd and 5th anniversary), sick leave (10 days, earned on an accrual basis), paid holidays (14) and floating holidays (2 days).
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Flexible Spending & Savings: FSA and HSA options to help manage healthcare costs.
Protection & Security: Short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance.
Future Planning: 401(k) retirement plan with a 5% company match.
Work-Life Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) through SupportLinc to provide confidential counseling and other wellbeing resources.

**Description du poste**
Sous la responsabilité du Domain Manager Retail Solutions, votre mission principale sera de jouer un rôle clé dans l'identification, l'analyse et la transformation des besoins métiers en solutions technologiques à forte valeur ajoutée.
En tant que Business Analyst IT, vous êtes le partenaire privilégié des équipes métiers pour identifier les opportunités d'amélioration, optimiser les processus et traduire les besoins business en solutions digitales créatrices de valeur. Vous accompagnez la transformation de nos parcours clients et contribuez à l-évolution de nos plateformes CRM et Retail afin d-offrir une expérience cohérente, personnalisée et omnicanale à nos clients à travers le monde.
Grâce à votre compréhension des enjeux métier et des capacités technologiques, vous contribuez à la définition de la feuille de route, à la priorisation des initiatives et à la réussite des projets stratégiques soutenant les ambitions d-Audemars Piguet.

s.h: Dans cadre-là, vos principales responsabilités seront de
s.t:
* Comprendre les besoins des équipes Commerciales et les traduire en solutions digitales créatrices de valeur
* Contribuer à la priorisation du portefeuille d-initiatives en fonction de leur valeur business, de leur impact et de leur faisabilité
* Animer les ateliers de cadrage, recueillir et formaliser les exigences métier sous forme de user stories, processus et spécifications fonctionnelles
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de développement, architecture, intégration et qualité afin de garantir des solutions adaptées aux besoins et conformes aux standards de l-entreprise
* Contribuer à la définition et à l-évolution de la feuille de route CRM et Retail en lien avec les objectifs stratégiques d-Audemars Piguet
* Participer aux phases de conception, de tests, de recette, de déploiement et d-accompagnement au changement afin de garantir l-adoption des solutions
* Assurer le suivi des initiatives, identifier les risques, proposer des plans de mitigation et communiquer l-avancement aux parties prenantes
* Analyser les performances des solutions et les retours utilisateurs afin d-identifier des opportunités d-amélioration continue et d-optimisation des processus
* Favoriser la collaboration entre les équipes métiers, les utilisateurs finaux, les partenaires externes et les équipes IT dans un environnement international
* Contribuer à l-innovation et à la transformation digitale des domaines CRM et Retail en identifiant les tendances, bonnes pratiques et nouvelles opportunités technologiques

* Expérience confirmée en tant que Business Analyst IT
* Expérience significative sur des projets CRM, Clienteling, Marketing ou Retail
* Expertise solide sur Salesforce Marketing Cloud
* Excellentes compétences en analyse, structuration et priorisation
* Expérience en pilotage de projets IT
* Aisance dans la communication avec des interlocuteurs variés (IT & métiers)

Interessierst du dich für intelligente Systeme, die täglich Millionen von Briefen und Paketen auf ihrem Weg begleiten? Begeisterst du dich dafür, komplexe Prozesse zu analysieren und gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln?

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung einer geschäftskritischen Codierlösung an der Schnittstelle von IT, Logistik und automatisierten Sortieranlagen. Mit dir sorgen wir für eine zuverlässige, zukunftsorientierte Verarbeitung von Sendungen in der ganzen Schweiz.
**Das kannst du bewirken**
* Du analysierst und dokumentierst fachliche sowie technische Bedürfnisse und leitest daraus klare, umsetzbare Systemanforderungen und Spezifikationen nach definierten Standards ab.
* Gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen, IT-Stellen und Softwarelieferanten entwickelst du Lösungsvarianten, klärst Schnittstellen, Abhängigkeiten, sowie Auswirkungen auf bestehende Prozesse, wodurch du deine Expertise optimal einbringst.
* Du koordinierst Änderungen zwischen Business, IT, Betrieb und externen Partner:innen und begleitest diese von der Anforderung bis zur produktiven Einführung.
* Du planst Releases, erstellst Testkonzepte und Testfälle, führst Integrationstests durch und stellst mit den Beteiligten die Produktionsreife sicher.
* Du analysierst Incidents über verschiedene Systeme, Schnittstellen und Verarbeitungsschritte hinweg, identifizierst mithilfe von Logs, Monitoring-Daten und Alerts deren Ursachen und leitest nachhaltige Lösungen zur Stabilisierung und Optimierung des Betriebs ab.
* Du gestaltest die technologische Weiterentwicklung unserer Anwendungslandschaft mit und setzt moderne, auch KI-gestützte Werkzeuge gezielt ein.
* Gemeinsam mit dem Team stellst du den zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher und übernimmst regelmässige Tages- und Pikettdienste.
**Das bringst du mit**
* Du verfügst über einen Hochschulabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Business-Analyse, im Application Management, System- und Integration Engineering oder in IT Operations mit.
* Du kannst fachliche Bedürfnisse in technische Anforderungen übersetzen und vermittelst sicher zwischen Business, Betrieb, Entwicklung und externen Partner:innen
* Dich begeistern komplexe Systeme, Schnittstellen und asynchrone Nachrichtenflüsse und du analysierst Fehlerbilder strukturiert anhand von Logs und Monitoring-Daten, wodurch du einen wertvollen Beitrag leistest.
* Du bringst Erfahrung mit Tests und Releases mit und übernimmst Verantwortung von der Analyse bis zur Einführung; Kenntnisse in AWS, Kubernetes, APIs, Kafka, MQTT, Splunk, Grafana oder Bild- und Texterkennung sind von Vorteil.
* Du kommunizierst mündlich und schriftlich sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch, arbeitest selbstständig sowie methodisch und bringst dich aktiv in agile Teams ein.
Du bist bereit, regelmässig in Bern sowie bei Bedarf an Standorten von Paket- und Briefzentren in der ganzen Schweiz vor Ort zu arbeiten.
